title: 'Torture, caste discrimination': IIT-Bombay student’s father seeks justice
content: Seeking justice, the father of a deceased IIT-Bombay student alleges that systemic torture and caste discrimination were catalysts for his son's suicide. In turn, authorities have opened an abetment of suicide case, applying the SC/ST Act, naming a senior professor and others in the complaint. The institution, however, denies these allegations, claiming full support for the ongoing inquiry.

title: ‘Path of deception closed’: Iran vows ‘no limits’ in retaliation if US attacks
content: Iran has issued a stern warning, promising unlimited retaliation and a decisive conflict if the US attacks or dismisses its demands. Through Qatari mediators, Tehran has proposed seven conditions for a truce to Washington. Officials in Iran stressed that any regional nations supporting the US would be drawn into the conflict. Parliament speaker Ghalibaf reiterated the dual approach of military readiness alongside diplomatic negotiations.

title: Asian Games Day 1 Medal Tally: Where India rank after two silvers in Aichi-Nagoya
content: India made a striking start at the Asian Games, capturing two silver medals in shooting events. Elavenil Valarivan was a standout, winning silvers both individually and as part of the team in the 10m air rifle competition. Additionally, the women's cricket team powered through to the finals, showcasing their strength, along with commendable starts from the hockey and table tennis teams, who also secured significant victories.

title: 'Brahmastra' actor in judicial custody after woman files complaint over marriage promise
content: Saurav Gurjar, known for his role in Mahabharat, has been placed in judicial custody following allegations from a woman who claims he deceived and harassed her under false promises of marriage. After meeting on Instagram and developing a relationship via WhatsApp, they lived together in the US and India, where Gurjar allegedly persuaded her to leave her job. Police have initiated an investigation into the actor's actions.

title: BCCI to draw line on Ombudsman’s jurisdiction over state-level matters | Exclusive
content: The move is understood to aim at drawing a clearer line between issues that fall within the Ombudsman’s jurisdiction and those that the respective state associations should address first.

title: Washington couple’s $50M retreat on Lake Washington lists for $71M
content: Dwayne and Terese Clark are selling their Lake Washington estate for seventy-one million dollars. This waterfront compound features two Mediterranean-style residences on two point three acres. The property includes a main house and a separate wellness retreat with pools. They are relocating to Arizona after investing fifty million dollars into the homes. The sale could set a new record for Pacific Northwest residential real estate.

title: Atlanta man arrested after phone wipe; new ruling allows border searches
content: US border agents can now search traveler cellphones without reasonable suspicion or a warrant. A recent court ruling affirmed this broad authority at international borders. This decision follows an incident where a phone was wiped during an airport search. The ruling impacts traveler privacy and government access to electronic data. It highlights ongoing debates about digital device searches at the border.

title: Asian Games: India open account with 2 shooting silvers as hockey, cricket, MMA shine
content: India opened its medal account with two silver medals in women's 10m air rifle competition. Suchika Tariyal secured at least a bronze medal in MMA's debut event. The women's cricket team advanced to the final after a dominant semifinal win. Both men's and women's hockey teams achieved emphatic victories in their opening matches. Badminton and table tennis teams also delivered strong performances on the opening day.

title: Trump adds drones, snipers and ammunition to plans for Washington triumphal arch
content: US President Trump announced plans to transform a proposed triumphal arch into a military complex. This new facility will house and deploy drones and snipers for national security. The structure is planned near Arlington Memorial Bridge, adjacent to the cemetery. Veterans have filed lawsuits challenging the arch's construction and sightline disruption. The Federal Aviation Administration has cleared aviation concerns for the proposed arch.

title: How Jordon Hudson became an important part of Bill Belichick’s life
content: Bill Belichick rarely discusses his personal life, making his comments about Jordon Hudson particularly notable. During a 2025 interview, he praised Hudson as “terrific” and “very helpful,” explaining that she supported him with business matters and his book while he focused on coaching at North Carolina. His remarks offered a glimpse into their relationship, emphasizing companionship, trust, support, and mutual perspective.

title: Vince and Linda McMahon net worth 2026: How they built their fortune
content: Vince and Linda McMahon built a global sports entertainment empire from a regional wrestling company. Their combined net worth is estimated at $3.2 billion, largely from WWE. WWE merged with UFC in 2023, creating TKO Group Holdings. Vince McMahon retains a significant stake in TKO, while Linda pursued politics. The couple also holds substantial real estate and other investments.

title: Is Trump's Greenland deal crucial for the US and Nato to counter Russia and China?
content: The GIUK Gap remains central to Nato's ability to monitor Russian submarine activity in the North Atlantic. If Scotland’s constitutional status ever complicates access to bases such as Faslane and Lossiemouth, Greenland’s strategic importance to Washington becomes even harder to ignore.

title: How one India T20I could become Japanese cricket's defining moment
content: Japan is set to host its first-ever men's senior international cricket match against India, marking a milestone for Japanese cricket. Growth has been steady, with rising participation and increased visibility. The match aims to win hearts, boost cricket's popularity, and showcase Japan's progress within the global cricket community.

title: CCTV shows BMW crashing through barrier, falling off Mumbai's Coastal Road bridge; 3 dead
content: In a devastating early morning crash, a speeding BMW plunged off Mumbai's Coastal Road bridge. This unfortunate event occurred at a construction site, resulting from the driver's loss of control. Three lives were claimed in the accident, with Shanay Gajjal and Dhirya Seth identified among the deceased; the third passenger’s identity remains unknown. Meanwhile, one individual is critically injured, leading authorities to start a thorough investigation into the circumstances.

title: India on track for 6.5-7% real GDP growth this fiscal, earnings seen accelerating
content: India anticipates 6.5-7 percent real GDP growth this fiscal year.  Bank credit expansion signals strong economic momentum and business activity.  Domestic demand remains firm, evidenced by rising GST and power consumption.  Corporate earnings growth is projected to accelerate to seventeen percent.  Energy price risks persist, though India diversifies its crude oil sources.

title: Day after Thar-cab road rage in Gurgaon, fresh car-ramming video surfaces
content: A day after a Thar was seen repeatedly ramming a cab in Gurgaon’s Sector 89, another road rage video surfaced from Sector 38 showing a Maruti Baleno and Hyundai Aura allegedly crashing into each other. A man is also seen being struck and narrowly escaping another apparent attempt to run him over, while police said no complaint or FIR had been registered in the case as of Saturday evening.

title: Neurosurgeon burnt alive after car slams into divider, bursts into flames in Telangana
content: In a heartbreaking event, Dr K Jagadeesh Babu, a leading neurosurgeon from Khammam, died when his car collided with a road divider and caught fire on NH-365BB. The incident, occurring near Pillalamarri in Suryapet district early Sunday, raises concerns as police attribute the crash to possible drowsiness, resulting in this devastating loss for the medical community and his loved ones.

title: Shafali’s ton helps India crush Bangladesh, storm into Asian Games final
content: Shafali Verma’s historic 100 off 49 balls powered India Women to 195/4 before their bowlers bundled Bangladesh out for 81 in 15.4 overs, sealing a 114-run win in the Asian Games 2026 semi-final. India booked a place in the gold-medal match against Sri Lanka, while Shafali became the first player to score a century in women’s Asian Games cricket.

title: Dilpreet's four-goal show headlines India's 13-1 rout of Indonesia at Asian Games
content: Defending champions India began their Asian Games men's hockey campaign in emphatic fashion, thrashing Indonesia 13-1 in their opening Pool A match. Dilpreet Singh led the rout with four goals, while Shilanand Lakra and Sukhjeet Singh scored twice each. India will next face Sri Lanka on Tuesday as they begin their title defence.

title: India's defence industry takes off: The numbers explained
content: India's defence manufacturing sector has transformed over the past decade, moving from heavy import dependence toward genuine domestic capability. Production hit a record Rs 1.78 lakh crore in 2025-26, more than double 2020-21 levels, against a Rs 3 lakh crore target by 2029, backed by a defence budget that has tripled since 2013-14. Exports are the standout metric, up 56-fold to a record Rs 38,424 crore, reaching 80+ countries, with private industry now contributing 45.16% of exports and a record 24% of production, a major structural shift from PSU dominance.

title: Friends thrash Thar driver, he rams SUV into their cab in Gurgaon
content: A quarrel among four men in Sector 89 escalated when one allegedly rammed his Thar into a Rapido cab carrying two of them, hitting it repeatedly. The three people inside the cab escaped unhurt, while police are tracing the men and verifying whether the Thar driver was intoxicated.

title: KKK 15: Rohit Shetty walks out of the set after Avinash’s serious claims
content: The latest promo of Khatron Ke Khiladi 15 hints at a heated exchange between Avinash Mishra, Karan Wahi and host Rohit Shetty. What begins as a disagreement between the contestants soon escalates when Avinash appears to suggest that Rohit is doing favours for Karan. Rohit is visibly upset by the remark and eventually walks out of the set.

title: North Korea fires ballistic missile amid rising regional tensions
content: In a provocative move, North Korea fired a ballistic missile from its eastern shores into the sea, escalating already heightened military tensions. This launch coincides with recent missile and drone drills conducted by Pyongyang. The situation has deteriorated following joint military exercises between South Korea, the US, and Japan, prompting North Korea to signal potential countermeasures against these perceived threats.

title: Fake Insta account, ‘Operation Honeymoon’: How Siya Goyal plotted fiancé's murder
content: Siya Goyal and Chetan Chaudhary allegedly used a fake social media account to lure her fiancé Ketan Agarwal.  The trio studied a past case and films before planning the businessman's murder.  They identified Lohagad Fort as a suitable location for the fatal fall.  The plan was executed on June 18, leading to Ketan's death in a gorge.  Police filed a comprehensive chargesheet based on extensive digital and forensic evidence.

title: Yudh Abhyas 2026: M777 howitzers roar as Indian, US forces showcase firepower in Rajasthan
content: During Exercise Yudh Abhyas 2026, Indian and US Army personnel showcased the impressive capabilities of the M777 howitzer. Gun crews highlighted its firepower and coordinated operations, while US troops shared valuable insights with Indian battery teams. This live demonstration, paired with a comprehensive lecture on tactical deployment, aims to boost interoperability and enhance military readiness in challenging mountainous environments.

title: Asian Games: MMA's Varun Sanyal medically unfit after dizziness during weight cut
content: Indian MMA fighter Varun Sanyal withdrew from the Asian Games after a medical issue. He experienced dizziness and muscle cramps during a weight cut sauna session. Sanyal, a medal prospect, was declared medically unfit for the competition. His teammate Suchika Tariyal advanced in her event, securing a medal. MMA's debut at the Asian Games faces challenges for Indian athletes.

title: Delhi pollution crackdown: Hotspots to be mapped, road works get Oct 31 deadline
content: In a concerted effort to tackle air pollution, the Delhi government is enhancing its oversight of environmental quality. District officials will create maps highlighting pollution hotspots and will identify nearby contributors to the problem. Agencies are tasked with implementing strategies and timelines for effective pollution management, with a deadline for finishing pending road and civil works set for October thirty-first.

title: China leads, US ranks 27th: Top 15 countries with highest math scores
content: China has recorded the highest mathematics score among 91 countries and economies in the latest global student assessment, with 612 points. Singapore, Macao and Chinese Taipei follow in the top four. The United States ranks 27th with 463 points, while Canada stands 11th. East Asian education systems dominate the rankings.
